title: Distinct catalog sources share a cache and removing one deletes the other's catalog
conditions: Two distinct registered sources whose owner/repository boundaries collapse to the same hyphenated key, for example acme-labs/agents and acme/labs-agents.
expected: Distinct source identities retain independent cache trees and provenance; removing one source preserves the other source's tree.
actual: Both humanRepoDir values are equal. The second source's cached definition is attributed to the first registry source. Removing the second source leaves the first registered but deletes its cache.
contractEvidence: packages/core/src/profile/catalog-store.concurrency.test.ts:114-124 explicitly expects removing one repository to preserve another tree.
evidenceLayer: Actual pure key function and actual local registry/catalog/details/removal paths on synthetic owned temporary directories; Desktop consumer is static evidence.
limits: No clone/add/update/install/network, real Desktop/native app, models, credentials, user data, cross-process publication, or installed-profile/portable-memory deletion was executed or claimed.
dedup: 810 prior audit/review/archived Markdown and JSON artifacts scanned; older Core lifecycle profile coverage read; no prior matching cache identity collision finding found.
